bib.title: OpenFlamingo: An Open-Source Framework for Training Large Autoregressive Vision-Language Models

question: Can an open-source replication of DeepMind's Flamingo, trained on open data with open LLMs, reach comparable few-shot vision-language performance?
contributions: Family of five open autoregressive VLMs from 3B to 9B parameters
Open training data recipe: LAION-2B, Multimodal C4, 417K ChatGPT-generated sequences
Documented hyperparameters and an evaluation suite over seven vision-language datasets

method.summary: Flamingo architecture reproduced: frozen CLIP ViT-L/14 and frozen causal LLM, with a trainable Perceiver resampler and gated dense cross-attention layers inserted into the LLM. Trained with next-token prediction on MMC4 interleaved data plus LAION-2B pairs; evaluated few-shot on seven datasets with 0-32 in-context examples.
method.task: interleaved image-text next-token prediction pretraining; few-shot captioning, VQA, rank classification

datasets.name: LAION-2B
datasets.preprocessing: captions truncated to 32 tokens; CLIP ViT-B/32 cosine similarity >= 0.28; median 1 image and 17 tokens per sequence

datasets.name: Multimodal C4 (MMC4)
datasets.source: open, CLIP soft-aligns images to sentences
datasets.preprocessing: drop images with CLIP ViT-L/14 similarity to subsequent text < 0.24; discard sequences with no images left; 1-6 images (median 2); reject single-image sequences with probability 0.5; median 256 tokens

datasets.name: ChatGPT-generated sequences
datasets.source: generated by ChatGPT, images retrieved from LAION-5B
datasets.preprocessing: 10 candidate images per caption (index laion5B-L-14, aesthetic score 9, aesthetic weight 0.5), re-ranked with CLIP ViT-L/16@336px; used only for 4B models (about 240K sequences within the 60M interleaved examples); median 3 images, 56 tokens

datasets.name: COCO, Flickr-30K, VQAv2, OK-VQA, TextVQA, VizWiz, HatefulMemes
datasets.split: splits used by Alayrac et al. (Flamingo); demonstrations sampled from the training split

models.name: OpenFlamingo-3B
models.architecture: CLIP ViT-L/14 + MPT-1B, cross-attention every layer, Perceiver resampler

other.note: numbers copied from Alayrac et al.

training.objective: next-token prediction; loss weights 1 (MMC4) and 0.2 (LAION-2B), Flamingo defaults
training.lr_schedule: linear increase at start, then constant at 1e-4
training.batch_size: LAION-2B batch is twice the interleaved batch; absolute size not stated
training.hardware: 64 GPUs across 8 nodes, Stability AI cluster; A100-80GB for OF-3B and OF-9B, A100-40GB for the others; FSDP for 4B, DDP otherwise

other.trainable: Perceiver resampler, cross-attention layers, and (except 4B) <image> and <|endofchunk|> embeddings; vision encoder and LM frozen
other.gradients: accumulated over both datasets between optimizer steps
other.fig8_axis: read from Fig 8: validation curves go to about 20K steps

inference.decoding: beam search, 3 beams; stop at 20 tokens (captioning), 5 tokens (VQA) or <|endofchunk|>; HatefulMemes: log-likelihood of 'yes' vs 'no'
inference.samples: 3 evaluation seeds, randomness over choice of in-context demonstrations, averaged
inference.prompting: 0, 4, 8, 16, 32 in-context examples; zero-shot uses two in-context examples with images removed; classification uses prompt ensembling over 6 permutations of examples; eval in automatic mixed precision, linear layers in bfloat16
inference.retrieval: RICES (Yang et al. 2022): top-k most similar training images by cosine similarity of frozen CLIP ViT-L/14 features; main text uses random demos

metrics.name: VQA accuracy
metrics.definition: exact match accuracy over a set of ground truth answers

baselines: fine-tuned SoTA (Table 8: mPLUG, Unified VLP, PaLI-17B, Hate-CLIPper)
eval.protocol: three seeds over demonstration sampling; mean and standard deviation reported; fine-tuned SoTA from Papers With Code on 06/19/23

availability.data: ChatGPT-generated sequences released via the repository; LAION-2B and MMC4 are public

prompts.text: <image> is an image with: '[text]' written on it. Is it hateful? Answer: [answer]

You are a helpful assistant that knows a lot about image descriptions and how they are used with text in broader contexts. Your job is to generate an interleaved sequence of images (referenced by their image descriptions) and sentences. [...] full prompt with 5 human-authored examples in Fig 12

limits: Authors: models carry the risks of their base LMs, train on web-scraped data and have no safety fine-tuning; may produce inappropriate or inaccurate outputs.
Gap to Flamingo widens with more in-context examples; authors speculate MMC4 has too few images per sequence.
Low VQA performance has an unclear cause; OK-VQA and TextVQA notably weaker than Flamingo.
4B models degrade after 4-8 shots; frozen embeddings tested only in a small OPT-125M 20M-sample experiment, single run.
No video support; no vision-language instruction tuning; results cover 0-32 shots only.
Absolute batch size, warmup length, step count and total compute are not stated.
VQAv2 validation was used as a development signal during model building.
Flamingo comparison uses numbers copied from the Flamingo paper, not re-run.
RICES hurts Flickr-30K because the model copies demonstration captions.
